Help
fields.options:
Uses Jinja templating (the same engine as Print Formats and Email Templates). Reference the source document's fields with the doc. prefix and the field's fieldname (not its label).

✅ Correct: Hi {{ doc.contact_person }}, invoice {{ doc.name }} of {{ doc.grand_total }} is due on {{ doc.due_date }}.

❌ Wrong: Hi {{ contact_person }} — a bare field name without doc. renders blank.

Tip: find a field's fieldname via the form's Menu → Customize, or hover the field. A field that is empty on the document will also render blank.

fields.description: Insert document fields with {{ doc.fieldname }} — e.g. {{ doc.contact_person }}. See the Help note above.
